summary: VolitionRx filed an 8-K reporting entry into a waiver and consent agreement with Lind Global Asset Management XII LLC on September 2, 2026. The waiver permits VolitionRx to make ATM sales exceeding the $10 million annual cap under an existing securities purchase agreement, amending prior restrictions related to convertible notes and warrants. Lind waived certain remedies and defaults tied to those sales. This is a routine financing accommodation, not a special-situation corporate event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No change in control, strategic review, or board action was announced. Watch for continued ATM issuance and potential dilution effects on existing shareholders.
